evidence: log loss +0.0125 (95% interval +0.0044 to +0.0202). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

394 picks, ROI -0.7% (95% interval -7.8% to +6.1%), win rate 58.9% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 27% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.12 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,915 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,770; a 1% edge takes 44,229. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
